text:
Sam H: quick heads-up — customer PINE-358 reporting invoice >> dashboard mismatch for Nov close. Dashboard total $4,200, invoice shows $5,400 (invoice# 2024-11-01-PI-9001). Can someone look?
Marta C: looked at the invoice lines — there's an extra line 'Reserved capacity (Enterprise) — prorated' for $1,200. That account is on Pro monthly, never opted into reserved.
Sam H: exact. dashboard export (CSV) only shows Pro base + usage overage $0. Invoice has that extra reserved line.
Lia (Billing): can you paste the subscription history for the account? need audit_id and plan change timestamps.
Sam H: pasted subscription history snippet:
```
account: PINE-358
subscriptions:
 - 2024-10-01 00:00 UTC : plan=Pro monthly (plan_id: pro-v2)
 - 2024-10-31 23:55 UTC : plan temporarily flagged=enterprise-reserved (auto-tag)
 - 2024-11-01 00:03 UTC : plan reverted=pro-v2
```

Marta C: interesting — 8 minute window where plan tag flips. customer definitely did not request a tier change.
Devon Ops: we had a config rollout (ribbon/tagging) at 2024-10-31 23:50 UTC that briefly applied the reserved-capacity ribbon to a subset of accounts. we rolled back at 00:05 UTC. looks like PINE-358 got caught in that window. incident ref IR-847.
Lia (Billing): that explains the reserved line. billing job for Nov cutover ran at 2024-11-01 00:00–00:10 UTC and likely picked up the transient tag.
billing-bot: automated-note: provisional_charge applied -> invoice 2024-11-01-PI-9001 : +$1,200 (metadata: audit_id=ir-847-attach).
Lia (Billing): next steps I propose: 1) regenerate invoice without the reserved line, 2) issue credit/adjustment if regeneration not possible, 3) add note to invoice and to account audit trail. Need sign-off for adjustments > $1k.
Marta C: customer requested corrected invoice before their month-close (EOD their timezone). they escalated. they prefer corrected invoice rather than a standalone credit.
Devon Ops: I can queue a manual re-run of the billing job for that account only (non-global), here's quick checklist:
- mark subscription canonical plan=pro-v2 in billing DB
- re-run per-account invoice generator with cutoff=2024-11-01T00:00Z
- verify line items vs dashboard export
- if mismatch persists, file for manual credit

Sam H: assigning to @Lia and @Devon. I'll update the customer with ETA (3 hours). tagging @marta for communication. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Lia (Billing): started work — pulled the billing job logs, found entry: `apply_plan_tags(account=PINE-358, tag=enterprise-reserved, source=ribbon-rollout, ts=170939... )`. I'll request Finance approval now.
Devon Ops: manual re-run scheduled, will post result here when completed. copying internal job id: rerun-20241101-PINE358-01.
billing-bot: rerun-complete: rerun-20241101-PINE358-01 -> regenerated invoice 2024-11-01-PI-9001-v2, removed reserved line, new total $4,200.
Lia (Billing): finance approved adjustment and regeneration. created credit note CN-2024-1101-45 for transparency, but invoice v2 is authoritative.
Marta C: updated customer — they confirmed they received corrected invoice and will accept the v2 doc for their close. :white_check_mark:
Sam H: closing here — root cause = transient plan-tag applied during ribbon rollout (IR-847) that coincided with billing cutover. action items: Devon to add a quick rollback-safe guard to plan tagging rollouts near billing cutover windows; Lia to add a validation check in the billing runner to ignore plan tag flips within 15 minutes of cutover. I'll create follow-up tasks.
Devon Ops: noted — will open RFC for rollout-window guard.
Lia (Billing): I'll add billing-run validation ticket and update runbook.
Sam H: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
